sets.name: The Coat Pocket of a Tall Man
sets.label: from one coat, one winter

comforts.name: The table edge
comforts.effect: A missed ball stops at the near edge of the table instead of rolling to the floor.

comforts.name: The clip
comforts.effect: One sock can be parked on a clip at the table edge while you keep looking.

comforts.name: A closer look
comforts.effect: The sock in your hand can be looked at a little bigger. It never marks the twin.

comforts.name: Kept as it was
comforts.effect: The room remembers your last ball style, basket, station and look.

comforts.name: A quiet open
comforts.effect: The slow drift into the room is skipped when you come back.

items.name: Half a Lip Balm
items.flavor: Survived the wash. Again.

items.name: The Guitar Pick
items.flavor: Knows four chords and one very long story.

items.name: Receipt Gone Soft
items.flavor: The total is now between us and the water.

items.name: The Spare Coat Button
items.flavor: Was included for a reason nobody remembers.

items.name: Coat Check Claim 47
items.flavor: The coat made it home. The number stayed.

items.name: One Tiny Screw
items.flavor: Definitely important to something. Probably not this.

items.name: The Blue Marble
items.flavor: Was missing for eleven minutes and blamed everyone.

items.name: Green Crayon Nub
items.flavor: Still has one drawing left in it.

items.name: A Very Small Wheel
items.flavor: Its vehicle has moved on without it.

items.name: Sticker Backing Star
items.flavor: The good part is on something else now.

items.name: Acorn Cap Only
items.flavor: The acorn had other plans.

items.name: Single Googly Eye
items.flavor: Has been watching the spin cycle professionally.

items.name: The Ticket Stub
items.flavor: The show was better than the parking.

items.name: One Earring Back
items.flavor: Its earring is doing fine somewhere else.

items.name: Paper Wristband
items.flavor: Entry granted. Getting back in seems unlikely.

items.name: Emergency Mint Wrapper
items.flavor: The emergency passed. The wrapper persisted.

items.name: One Foil Star
items.flavor: Stayed for cleanup. Nobody asked it to.

items.name: Photo Booth Strip, Mostly Gone
items.flavor: The water kept the part that mattered.

items.name: The Bobby Pin
items.flavor: Has escaped every bathroom drawer it ever entered.

items.name: Closed Safety Pin
items.flavor: Closed before washing. A professional.

items.name: Eleven Inches of Tape Measure
items.flavor: The remaining inches declined to participate.

items.name: The Hair Tie
items.flavor: Stretched past dignity, still technically employed.

items.name: Three Notes, Now One
items.flavor: Whatever they said has become very concise.

items.name: The Spare Shoelace
items.flavor: Never met the shoe it was promised.

items.name: The Washer
items.flavor: Not the appliance. Somehow less useful.

items.name: Bread Tag, Blue
items.flavor: No bread has claimed it in weeks.

items.name: The Good Pebble
items.flavor: Picked for a reason. The reason remains solid.

items.name: Cap to Something
items.flavor: Its bottle has entered witness protection.

items.name: Room 214 Keycard
items.flavor: Checkout was at eleven. It missed the meeting.

items.name: The Brass Key to Nothing Here
items.flavor: Has remained optimistic about this door.
